title: H0373 (2024 Regular): Conditions of Pretrial Release

operative_text: Section 1 (new s. 903.047(4), F.S.): Notwithstanding any other law, a defendant may not be required to surrender a license to carry a concealed weapon or concealed firearm in conjunction with a first misdemeanor offense unless it appears that the defendant would present a danger to the public if he or she were to possess the concealed weapon or concealed firearm.
